sentences.text: Shri Lalit Sharma - Advocate for the petitioner.
Ms. Anjali Gyanani - Government Advocate for the State.

Today corpus is produced by Women Sub-Inspector, Ms. Nand
 Sharma and Head Constable, Raghunandan Singh, Police Station Am
 District Morena.
 2.
Instant petition is in the nature of habeas corpus.
As  daughter of petitioner was in illegal confinement of respondent As submitted, minor daughter of petitioner aged 17 years was missing and was in illegal confinement of respondents no.4 and 5.
They allured daughter of petitioner to live with them under live-in-relationship.

3. Counsel for the respondent/State informs this Court that case is being registered at the instance of petitioner against respondents no.4 and 5 for offence under Sections 363, 366, 376 of IPC r/w Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
Therefore, respondent no.4 Golu @Nitin is suffering confinement.
4. When this Court raised specific query from corpus, then she at present is not interested in going to her parents' home.
She wants to live with respondent no.4.
However, respondent no.4 is in jail.
5. Looking to the age and mental status of corpus, it is better that she be confined to One Stop Center, Morena so that she may take some time to contemplate.

During her stay at One Stop Center,
Sub-Inspector, Ms.Nandani 2 WP-35507-2025 Sharma and if possible Ms. Anjali Gyanani,
Government Advocate shall undertake counselling sessions of corpus and intimate the Court about the outcome on the next date of hearing.
